title: AIIMS Delhi Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Multi Tasking Staff Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for Multi-Tasking Staff Jobs. Those candidates who have passed the 10th can use this opportunity and apply for the AIIMS Delhi Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the application ends. ...
